selection_policy: Fit preprocessing/train parameters on train only; choose hyperparameters/checkpoints on validation only; freeze once before scoring test/external. Fixed split across training seeds.

absolute_affinity.gold: Experimental exact Kd with resolved concentration unit; pKd=-log10(Kd/M). Ki/IC50 and author mixed pAffinity are separate endpoints.

modification_effect.gold: Within-comparable-condition observed WT/mutant pair; retain source observations and shared-reference dependencies. Delta-pKd=mutant minus WT, positive strengthens; DDG sign and unit follow separately verified source.
prohibited: Infer independent measurement from graph-neighbour relation alone

interaction_classification.gold: Author experimental binary, assay-censored nonbinding, structure-derived positive/sampled-negative, and affinity-threshold-derived binary remain different tracks. Threshold derived labels require predeclared cutoff and assay scope.
prohibited: Measurement zero sentinel means certain negative

contact_site.gold: Observed experimental complex coordinate-derived residue contact, minimum non-hydrogen atom distance <=5 angstrom unless a separately named track declares another rule. Preserve chain mapping, unresolved residues and source PDBs.
prohibited: True peptide coordinates/contact features fed to sequence-only site predictor
Attention map called verified binding site

statistical_units: Preserve repeated assays and shared WT. Confidence intervals/group summaries should reflect source/mother/target rather than treating paired expansions as independent. Seed SD measures fitting variability only.
external_policy: A resource can be training augmentation or external test in a given track, not both. Audit study DOI/PMID, chemical identity, target construct/homology, pair/PDB and published checkpoint exposure. Do not certify external independence from database name alone.
comparison_policy: Evaluate every method on its actual admissible track. All-common-subset and per-method coverage are both required when exclusions differ. Native task reproduction, common-data training, head adaptation and released-output reanalysis are separate labels. Unsupported combinations must stay visible.
